_template_notes.purpose: Per-lane signals output — Phase 4 Coverage Dispatch. 1 file = 1 writer (lane agent ownership). Shared schema với wf-fix-bugs lane signals. Tham chiếu 04-file-contract.md §4.6. Version bump signals-v1 → v2 PHẢI coordinate cả 2 skills (wf-cmi + wf-fix-bugs).
populate: lane: CD{N} dimension ID (vd CD1, CD2, ...)
agent_subagent_type: agent chính của lane (vd 'business-analyst' cho CD1, 'architect' cho CD2/CD3, 'api-tester' cho CD4)
scan_duration_sec: thời gian agent execute (set khi agent COMPLETED)

signals[]: 1 entry per finding — {fingerprint (sha256 dedup), dim (CD{N}), severity=MUST|SHOULD|MAY|INFO, category=MISSING_INVARIANT|VIOLATION|GAP|RECOMMENDATION, rule_id (vd INV-CRM-001), message (tiếng Việt), affected_files[], evidence[], suggested_action}
fingerprint generation: sha256(lane + rule_id + sorted(affected_files) + message)
STATUS_PASS_FAIL: PASS nếu agent completed, FAIL nếu timeout/crash/schema invalid
